Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for the call last week. Per our conversation, I’m kicking off the renewal coordination for Novamed’s 2025 term refresh (deal D-4837). Goal: agree on a short uplift sprint to secure the additional capacity you signaled, lock in a 12-month term amendment, and schedule our QBR to review integration items and expected traffic patterns.

Proposed next steps (high level):
- Run a 3-week uplift sprint (engineering + CS checkpoints) to validate load profiles and sizing
- Share a draft term amendment for review (attached)
- Schedule a QBR in the next 3 weeks to align execs and platform leads

Initial QBR windows (pick one):
1) Tue 3 Jun, 10:00–11:00 PT
2) Wed 4 Jun, 14:00–15:00 PT
3) Fri 6 Jun, 08:30–09:30 PT

I’ve attached a short Renewal_Playbook_v1.pdf that outlines responsibilities and a Draft_Term_Amendment.docx for your legal/procurement to review. Can you confirm which QBR window works, and please loop in your procurement contact so we can expedite the term changes?

If helpful, I’ll run an internal alignment session with our SRE and dedicated capacity team (cc’d: Vanessa and Karthik) once we lock the window.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
